en: The postcard features a stylized tree with red fruits and banners listing the names Liestal, Therwil, Böckten, and Waldenburg. At the center of the tree is the phrase '100 Jahre' (100 years), and at the roots is the year 1836. The tree's trunk contains a heraldic shield with a red bishop's crozier on a white background, which is the coat of arms of Basel-Landschaft. The top of the postcard reads 'Jahrhundert-Feier der Bezirks-Schulen' (Centenary Celebration of District Schools), and the year 1936 is also prominently displayed.
